description: This Java class 'UserService' provides user management functionalities such as creating, updating, and patching user details within a Spring-based application. It interacts with repositories to persist user data and handles password encoding and group assignment.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: Service class for managing user creation, updating, and patching functionalities in the application.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a new user after validating unique username and email, encodes the password, and assigns a default 'USER' group.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the existing user's basic details such as name, email, and image URL.

methods.name: patch
methods.description: Partially updates user details, specifically the 'detalle' field.
